text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Three hundred families who built houses under Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) power lines in the northern Copperbelt province are to be evicted for their own safety.
- Sixteen Zairean children fleeing the war in their country cross into Zambia unaccompanied.
- FIFA, the world's soccer governing body, has ruled that Zambia will play the crucial world cup soccer qualifier against Zaire in Zimbabwe instead of war-torn Zaire.
- About 200 civilians from Zaire crossed into Zambia last Monday following the capture of Kasenga district by advancing rebels.
- The chartered institute of transporters has called for the arrest of contracters who did shoddy work on roads in Lusaka last year.
- The weather bureau has advised farmers to harvest their crops now to save them from damage by continued rains.
